name: Tailsight
summary: AI maintenance planning and optimization for airline tech ops. It pulls together maintenance systems, flight schedules, staffing, station capability and parts availability to build plans that respect real constraints. Alaska Airlines is the first major airline to deploy it and invested in the company (April 16, 2026).
paragraphs: AI maintenance planning and optimization for airline tech ops. It pulls together maintenance systems, flight schedules, staffing, station capability and parts availability to build plans that respect real constraints. Alaska Airlines is the first major airline to deploy it and invested in the company (April 16, 2026).
whyItMatters: Plans that ignore labor, parts or station capability fall apart overnight. Tailsight is aimed at labor and parts utilization and at reducing AOG time, the KPIs a VP of maintenance actually reports.
